help.title: How Sessions Work
help.intro: Sessions help group tournaments by playing day and track results in real time.
help.startDesc: Click 'Start Session' to open a playing day. Then add tournaments via 'Start Tournament'. Select room, tournament and fill in the result.
help.endDayDesc: When all tournaments are done, click 'Finish Session'. Any unfinished tournaments will be marked as played with no winnings.
help.tableDesc: The table shows all played tournaments. You can filter by room, tournament, date and range. Export to Excel and JSON is available.

help.title: How Bankroll Works
help.intro: Bankroll is your total gaming budget, automatically updated with each tournament and manually via deposit/withdraw operations.

cards.title: Summary Cards
cards.content: Cards show: total bankroll balance, total tournament profit, and manual operations total. All amounts are shown in USD, with RUB and EUR conversion below.

rooms.title: Room Blocks
rooms.content: Each room shows its current balance with deposit/withdraw buttons. The count of active sessions in that room is shown on the right.

manual.title: Manual Operations
manual.content: Use 'Deposit' or 'Withdraw' buttons under a room to manually adjust the balance — e.g. for bank transfers or fund withdrawals.

history.title: Operation History
history.content: All operations (automatic and manual) are shown on the 'Movements' page, where you can filter by date, room, and operation type.

help.title: How to Read Movements
help.intro: All money operations are shown here: wins, losses, deposits and bankroll withdrawals.
help.filtersDesc: Filter entries by date (from/to), room and operation type. Sorting is available: newest or oldest first.
help.typesDesc: Win — tournament prize. Loss — tournament buy-in. Deposit — manual bankroll deposit. Withdrawal — manual fund withdrawal.

help.title: How to Manage Tournaments
help.intro: Here you create and edit poker rooms and tournaments that are used in game sessions.
help.roomsDesc: Add poker rooms (PokerStars, GG Poker, etc.). You can quick-select popular rooms or create your own. Each room has a default currency.
help.tournamentsDesc: Inside each room you can add unlimited tournaments with buy-in, currency, level and type.
help.typesDesc: In settings you can define custom tournament types (e.g. MTT, SnG, Spin&Go) which are displayed in the session table.

stats.negativeProfit: Negative profit — backer share not accrued

info.negativeProfit: Negative profit — backer share reduces total debt

help.title: How Backing Works
help.intro: Backing is when an investor (backer) pays part of the buy-ins in exchange for a share of winnings.
help.backersDesc: Add a backer with their stake percentage. For each backer, received and paid amounts are calculated automatically.
help.distributionDesc: Each room shows: how much the backer paid in buy-ins, profit generated, how much has been paid out and remaining to pay.
help.historyDesc: The history table shows all receiving and payment operations with the backer. You can add, edit and delete entries.

help.title: How to Read Reports
help.intro: Reports show your poker statistics for the selected period as charts and tables.
help.graphsDesc: Charts show bankroll dynamics, daily profit and distribution by room. You can switch between different currencies.
help.filtersDesc: Use filters by date and room to analyze results for a specific period or in a specific poker room.

room.label: Room — What Is It?
room.content: A room is a poker platform (PokerStars, GG Poker, CoinPoker, etc.). All tournaments are grouped by room. You can add, edit and delete rooms on the «Tournaments» page.

tournament.label: Tournament — How to Add?
tournament.content: On the «Tournaments» page, select a room and click «Add Tournament». Enter the name, buy-in and currency. Once created, the tournament will appear in the list available for a new session.

session.label: Game Session — What Is It?
session.content: A session is one played tournament. On the «Sessions» page, click «Start Tournament», select a room and tournament, specify a backer (if any) and save. After saving, the session appears in the table with column sorting and pagination (20 rows by default). You can edit fields (backing, place, prize, bounty) directly in the table row.

finish.label: How to Start a Session?
finish.content: A session is a group of tournaments for one playing day. To start, click «Start Session» — a game session opens, then the «Start Tournament» button becomes available. Add tournaments one by one, filling in results. When all tournaments for the day are played or you want to end the day, click «Finish Session» — all unfinished tournaments will be marked as played without winnings. Completed sessions can be viewed in the table with date filtering.

bankroll.label: Bankroll — How It Works
bankroll.content: Bankroll automatically calculates the balance for each room: tournament profit + manual operations. You can deposit (+) or withdraw (-) funds in any currency (USD/EUR/RUB). Exchange rates can be edited manually or fetched from the internet (refresh button). Each room can have its display currency (USD/EUR/RUB) using buttons at the bottom of the card. «Backer paid» operations don't affect room balance — they only appear in history.

reports.label: Reports — What's There?
reports.intro: The «Reports» page contains charts and statistics:

list.expensesDesc: statistics: tournaments played, total buy-ins, total won, top-10 worst tournaments

reports.footer: At the top you can select the display currency and filter by room or tournament.

currencies.label: Currencies — How to Configure?
currencies.content: The app supports three currencies: USD, EUR, RUB. All amounts are stored in USD in the database. Exchange rates are set on the «Bankroll» page. You can enter them manually or click the refresh button to fetch current rates from exchangerate-api.com. Rates are saved in localStorage and persist on reload. For each room you can select a display currency (USD/EUR/RUB) — balance will be shown in RUB and EUR at current rates while the base value stays in USD.

backing.label: Backing — How It Works
backing.intro: On the «Backing» page you can manage backers (investors) who fund your tournaments.

list.addDesc: specify a name and profit percentage. You can add multiple backers with different percentages.
list.linkDesc: when creating a session, select a backer (if there are several). If there's only one backer, they are selected automatically.
list.opsDesc: "Receive" (backer sent money), "Pay" (you send money to backer), "Payout from own funds" (backer paid tournament directly — doesn't affect room balance).
list.debtDesc: automatically calculated: backer share + received - paid - paid by backer.
list.historyDesc: all operations with filters by room and date, with edit and delete capabilities.

movements.label: Movements — What Is It?
movements.intro: The «Movements» page shows all financial operations in chronological order:

list.winsDesc: tournament results (all currencies are converted to USD)

movements.footer: Filtering is available by room, operation type, date, and sorting (newest/oldest first). Pagination — 20 records per page.

training.label: Matrix Trainer — How to Use?
training.content: The «Training» page has two tabs: «Editor» and «Trainer». In the Editor, create poker range matrices: name colors, paint hands, add a description, adjust weights. In the Trainer, you can practice in two modes — Classic (verify correct actions) and Drawing (draw a range and compare with the correct answer).

backup.label: Backup
backup.desc1: All data is stored in the server/db.json file in the project folder. As long as the server is running (node server/index.js), the app reads and writes data to this file. You can open it in any text editor, copy it, commit to git, or replace it.

clearModal.title: Clear all sessions and operations?
clearModal.content: All game sessions and bankroll operations will be deleted. Manual data and tournaments will remain.

goals.label: Goals — How Do They Work?
goals.content: On the «Goals» page you can set a target by tournament count and/or profit in USD. Progress is shown on the goal card. When a goal is reached, it auto-marks as completed. Completed goals can be viewed in the archive. A goal is considered met when any threshold is reached (tournaments OR profit).

license.label: License & Trial — How It Works
license.content: On first launch, a 14-day trial is activated. To purchase the full version: message @PokerDiary_Bot, use /buy, pay USDT (TRC-20), get your key, and activate it in the app. Online activation (enter key) and offline (challenge-response via bot) are supported. A 7-day grace period applies if the server is unreachable. The license is re-validated every 60 minutes and on startup. Up to 3 devices per key.

theme.label: Dark/Light Theme
theme.content: The theme toggle is in the right part of the header (sun/moon icon). Switching is instant and persists across sessions.

menuOrder.label: How to reorder menu items?
menuOrder.content: At the bottom of the sidebar there is a menu icon button. Click it — menu items become draggable. Drag them into your desired order and click the green checkmark to save.

excel.label: Excel Export — What's Included?
excel.content: The «Export to Excel» button creates a file with 4 sheets: Rooms (room list), Tournaments (tournaments with buy-in), Sessions (all sessions with place and prize), Bankroll (bankroll operations). The file is saved to your Downloads folder.

help.title: How Goals Work
help.intro: Goals help track your progress: set a tournament count target and optionally a profit target.
help.createDesc: Click 'Add Goal', set the number of tournaments and optionally a profit target in USD. Tracking starts automatically.
help.activeDesc: Active goals show progress: how many tournaments played and current profit. When conditions are met, click 'Complete'.
help.completedDesc: Completed goals can be viewed by expanding the section. They show statistics for the period.

help.title: How to Use the Trainer
help.intro: The matrix trainer helps you learn and memorize hand ranges for different game situations.
help.editorDesc: Create and edit range matrices. Color cells to represent actions (raise, call, fold). You can create folders for organization.
help.trainerDesc: The trainer shows random hands — mark whether the hand is in the selected range. After answering, the correct result is shown. Train your range memorization!

equity.unprofitableCall: Call is -EV — odds not high enough

help.title: How It Works
help.intro: This tool helps you decide whether to call your opponent's bet.
help.equityDesc: Pick your hand and your opponent's hand on the grid. Enter the pot and call amount. The calculator shows if your odds are good enough.
help.potOddsDesc: Simple ratio: how much to call vs the current pot. The smaller the call relative to the pot, the better.
help.bountyDesc: If the tournament has a bounty on your opponent's head, it gets added to the pot. Bounties make calls more profitable.
help.mysteryDesc: Bounty amounts can vary. Set the minimum and maximum — the calculator shows your equity range and expected value.
help.analysisDesc: Select Hero's range and board cards (flop/turn/river). The calculator shows how your range hits the board — combos and percentages for pairs, draws, straights, etc.
